title: Carpenter Estimate Template
subtitle: An estimate pre-filled for carpentry work — cabinetry, trim, decking, doors, framing and materials. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit secures the job; balance due on completion.
notes: This is an estimate, not a final invoice. Final charges may vary with material prices and site conditions.
features: Auto-calculating totals and 25% deposit in Excel
Pre-filled carpentry line items: cabinetry, trim, decking, doors, framing, materials
Valid-until date + deposit section standard for carpentry quotes
License # field — most states require a contractor license on client-facing estimates

faqs.q: What should I include on a carpenter estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (cabinetry, trim, decking, doors, framing), material cost, a validity date, deposit terms, and exclusions. Note that the estimate is not a final invoice.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
